dogecoin.text:
@elonmusk @dogecoin_devs Each coin would have different denominatons representing different breeds.

Owners love their dogs and love to buy and collect things that looks like their own pets. DOGE coins with real dog breeds would be an amazing collectable and possibly store of value.

@elonmusk @dogecoin_devs All of the dog clubs sell items for many different breeds. A great use case could be to reach out to the  various dog breeding clubs (AKC, FCI, UKC, etc..) to develop partnerships for the distribution of DOGE coins backed by crypto assets.

@elonmusk @dogecoin_devs Crypto coins can see adoption faster by developing use cases. Even with the rapid acceptance of crypro there is still none that has reached enough critical adoption and banking acceptance to warrant the production or real coins backed by the coins.
